# Join Geometry

Combines several inputs into one; splats with different SH degrees are padded to the highest.

`lfs.join_geometry` · Geometry

## How to use

Connect several Geometry outputs to the same input.  
Use after Separate Geometry to reunite branches.  
Overlapping copies remain separate splats, points or mesh faces.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | accepts multiple links | Geometry sources to combine. Connect several links here; an unconnected input gives an empty result. |
